scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && vitest run && pnpm --filter @portfolio/api test:workers
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @portfolio/web build && pnpm --filter @portfolio/api build
scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "pnpm --filter @portfolio/web dev" "pnpm --filter @portfolio/api dev"
scripts.benchmark:import: pnpm build:packages && node scripts/benchmark-import.ts && node scripts/benchmark-document-orders.ts
